component.name: NEFORUM
component.summary: Write a post once, publish it on every social network

description.p: NEFORUM is a free and open-source cross-poster. Write a post once: NEFORUM adapts it for each network (character limits, threads, hashtags, links, media rules), shows a live preview of every version, and publishes it everywhere at once or on a schedule.
Three ways to post, per account:

ul.li: Automatic through open APIs: Mastodon and the fediverse, Bluesky, Nostr, Misskey, Lemmy, Matrix, Telegram, Discord, WordPress, Ghost and more
Automatic with your own developer keys: X, Threads, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest, Tumblr, Facebook Pages and others
Hand-off for every other account: the text is copied, the photos saved and the network's composer opened, so you only press Post

description.p: NEFORUM is local-first. There is no NEFORUM server or account: posts go straight from your computer to each network, keys and tokens stay in the system keyring, and there are no analytics. An optional update check asks neforus.com for the latest version number only.

screenshot.caption: One post with a live preview for every network

description.p: NEFORUM starts on Linux systems without WebKitGTK. A sign-in component that NEFORUM uses only on phones and Macs needed it, so the app would not open where it was missing; on Linux, sign-in goes through your own browser, and the build no longer depends on WebKit at all.

A fix update. The browser extension (1.1.4) has an I posted it button on the page, and it sees a post you make with the site's own Post button (TikTok), so the hand-off moves on to the next network. YouTube Posts' Attach puts the photo into the post box through its image button instead of the search bar. A caption in a block above a TikTok or Instagram photo takes only the room its words need, with the photo right under it, and centred words sit in the middle of the frame; the caption editor's preview keeps the network's shape. With Post + Story on Instagram, the story's photo gets the caption written on it too. Lemmy gets a sound file as a video that plays in the post, and NEFORUM checks the instance kept its sound. YouTube with your own keys is now called YouTube videos, says plainly that it uploads videos, and takes a category, made-for-kids and altered-content choices and a custom thumbnail; YouTube Posts takes a words-only post with the post's text card, or as text only. The Linux desktop entry passes the AppImage catalog's validator.

Posting shows real progress for each network: what it is doing and how much of each file the server has received, never a made-up number. Results are reported per network, with a notification when it finishes. Mastodon uploads that a slow connection cut off are now handled safely and never post twice. On phones, accounts are picked from a grid that shows every account at once. Fonts can be searched and installed from free, keyless sources inside the font picker, only after you agree to use the network. Mouse side buttons go back and forward on computers. Schedule a post at a random time inside a range you choose, and confirm it first. Every connection shows when its sign-in runs out, on one page that separates sign-ins that renew themselves from ones you must reconnect, with warnings before the date. Computers get an emoji picker with search, recent emoji and skin tones.

Each account card shows how the account is connected: the method, the developer app or server, and what it is allowed to do, never its keys. Sync carries the exact setup between devices, media hosts and connections included, shows what joining will do before it changes anything, starts from the device with the most accounts, and merges the same account into one instead of making copies. The text card editor lets you edit the @handle and gives far more control over the card's layout, so words and the handle never cover the picture.

Photo dumps go out whole: more photos and videos than a network takes in one post are split by its own limits, in your order, into further posts of a thread on X, Bluesky, Mastodon and Misskey, and into a numbered series of posts elsewhere, instead of being dropped. The preview shows every post, and a thread or series that breaks off is finished by Retry without posting anything twice.

One editor for the text card of every network: set the design, font, signature and @handle once for all of them, see what still differs, and make them match in one tap. Sound videos show the whole photo or cover art, fitted to the frame, instead of cutting its sides off. Browser extension 1.1.3.

Sound files bring their own details: title, artist, album, year and cover from the file's tags go to every network that shows them, and every detail can be edited. A card designer for text cards and sound-video pictures, with templates, any installed font, cover art and waveforms. Every network shows its text card preview. A see-through sidebar.

The first Linux release. Also new: sound files (MP3 or the lossless original), documents turned into threads, Stories, a time per network, smaller copies of videos that are too big, video previews, installed fonts for captions, more text card backgrounds, the colour wheel and background pictures.
